description: Source code implementing the Bbr2ProbeBwMode class, which manages bandwidth probing cycles in the BBRv2 congestion control algorithm for QUIC.

classes.name: Bbr2ProbeBwMode
classes.description: Manages bandwidth probing cycles in BBRv2 congestion control, including phases like PROBE_UP, PROBE_DOWN, PROBE_CRUISE, and PROBE_REFILL.

classes.name: Bbr2ProbeBwMode::DebugState
classes.description: Struct for exporting debug state of the probing cycle.

methods.name: Enter
methods.description: Handles entering the probing mode, initializing or transitioning from other phases.

methods.name: OnCongestionEvent
methods.description: Updates the probing cycle based on congestion events, possibly switching modes.

methods.name: GetCwndLimits
methods.description: Returns congestion window limits based on current phase.

methods.name: IsProbingForBandwidth
methods.description: Checks if currently in a bandwidth probing phase.

methods.name: OnExitQuiescence
methods.description: Handles logic when exiting quiescence, postponing min RTT timestamp.

methods.name: UpdateProbeDown
methods.description: Updates state during PROBE_DOWN phase, possibly transitioning to other phases.

methods.name: MaybeAdaptUpperBounds
methods.description: Adjusts upper bounds for inflight based on congestion feedback.

methods.name: IsTimeToProbeBandwidth
methods.description: Determines if it's time to probe for bandwidth based on cycle timing.

methods.name: HasStayedLongEnoughInProbeDown
methods.description: Checks if the flow has stayed long enough in PROBE_DOWN to consider exiting.

methods.name: HasCycleLasted
methods.description: Checks if the current cycle has lasted longer than a specified duration.

methods.name: HasPhaseLasted
methods.description: Checks if the current phase has lasted longer than a specified duration.

methods.name: IsTimeToProbeForRenoCoexistence
methods.description: Determines if it's time to probe for Reno coexistence based on rounds.

methods.name: RaiseInflightHighSlope
methods.description: Increases the inflight high slope during PROBE_UP phase.

methods.name: ProbeInflightHighUpward
methods.description: Increases inflight_hi during PROBE_UP based on feedback.

methods.name: UpdateProbeCruise
methods.description: Updates state during PROBE_CRUISE phase.

methods.name: UpdateProbeRefill
methods.description: Updates state during PROBE_REFILL phase.

methods.name: UpdateProbeUp
methods.description: Updates state during PROBE_UP phase, possibly transitioning to other phases.

methods.name: EnterProbeDown
methods.description: Transitions to PROBE_DOWN phase, resetting relevant parameters.

methods.name: EnterProbeCruise
methods.description: Transitions to PROBE_CRUISE phase.

methods.name: EnterProbeRefill
methods.description: Transitions to PROBE_REFILL phase.

methods.name: EnterProbeUp
methods.description: Transitions to PROBE_UP phase.

methods.name: ExitProbeDown
methods.description: Ends PROBE_DOWN phase, possibly updating max bandwidth filter.

methods.name: CyclePhaseToString
methods.description: Converts cycle phase enum to string.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Overloads stream output for CyclePhase and DebugState.

methods.name: ExportDebugState
methods.description: Exports current debug state.

methods.name: Params
methods.description: Returns current parameters for the probing mode.

methods.name: PacingGainForPhase
methods.description: Returns pacing gain based on current phase.
